transcript: Many people fear aging, but aging is not the enemy. What you are truly afraid of is being forgotten, being unseen, feeling that your best moments are behind you. But listen carefully. Every year adds depth to your spirit, not distance from your worth. Your body changes, yes, but your wisdom grows, your compassion expands and your presence becomes softer, stronger and more meaningful. The lines on your face are not signs of losing beauty. They are proof that you lived, that you loved, that you felt deeply. Release the fear of becoming older. It steals the joy of the life you still haven't lived. You are not running out of time. You are becoming someone time cannot diminish. Aging is not moving toward the end. It is moving toward truth, clarity and peace. Before you scroll, comment peace. So this reaches more people and send this to one person who needs this reminder today.
